subject: Token consumption check + early commitment / incentive ask
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@olivetech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Token consumption check + early commitment / incentive ask

Hi Alex — great speaking earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Call notes (short):
- OliveTech MVP will use the API for user-facing summarization + two background enrichment jobs.
- Expected initial cadence: ~10–15M tokens/month for first 2 months, stepping to 30–50M tokens/month by month 6 if adoption goes well.
- Primary constraint: seed runway (12 months), finance is very price-sensitive.

A few follow-ups I promised:
1) Can you confirm a target budget range ($/month or $/1M tokens) you’d be comfortable with for the MVP months? That helps us shape a proposal.
2) You mentioned interest in a startup program / founder credit and also asked about committed-use discounts. Do you prefer an upfront monthly commit (12 months) or a smaller upfront + burst buffer?
3) If you can share a simple token burn CSV for the MVP (estimates by feature), I’ll load it into our pricing workbook and return 3 scenarios: pay-as-you-go, 12mo committed tier, and 2yr blended incentive.

Next steps: if you can reply with (a) budget range target ($ per 1M tokens), (b) rough monthly breakouts or confirm the 10–50M range above, I’ll draft those scenarios and loop in Revenue for approvals. I’ll include a conservative target $/1M token range as a starting point unless you give a number.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: none in this message
From: Alex Moreno <alex@olivetech.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Token consumption check + early commitment / incentive ask

Hi Hannah — thanks for the concise recap. Confirming a few things and adding context from our side: 

Budget and runway:
- We are pre-series A (seed) with ~12 months runway dependent on financing.
- For the MVP, our finance lead said target spend is roughly $6k–$12k/month for infra + inference. That means we’re looking for an effective target in the ballpark of $600–$900 per 1M tokens initially (we know there’s scale benefit later).

Estimated burn profile (rough):
- Month 1–2: 12M tokens/month (chat + batch),
- Month 3–6: 25–35M tokens/month,
- Month 7–12: 40–60M tokens/month if adoption accelerates.

Discount ask:
- We’re eligible for typical early-stage programs but our finance team asked whether there’s an add-on for committed use (12mo) and if there are multi-year incentives for a larger commit once we have ARR. Ideally: founder credit to offset initial spikes and then a committed-use discount for steady months.

Can you send a worksheet with a few price points (payg vs 12mo commit vs 2yr blended) so we can model against cap table scenarios? I attached a quick CSV with feature-level token guesses.

Appreciate it —
Alex Moreno
Co-founder & Head of Product | OliveTech
alex@olivetech.com

Attachments: MVP_token_estimate.csv
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@olivetech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 13:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Token consumption check + early commitment / incentive ask

Thanks Alex — this is exactly what we needed. Looping in Marissa (Revenue Ops) to weigh in on program options and Jordan (solutions) in case we want a 20–30 minute technical calibration on tokenization assumptions.

High-level approach from our side:
- I’ll load your CSV into our pricing workbook and produce three scenarios: (A) pay-as-you-go (baseline), (B) 12-month committed tier with a graduated discount schedule, (C) 24-month blended incentive that includes an upfront founder credit and deeper per-token reductions at scale.
- We won’t propose any formal legal commitments in the workbook — scenarios only. Any contracted pricing will be subject to standard approvals.

Proposed timing: I’ll have the workbook back to you by EOD Wed (our time) so you can review with your finance lead. If those look reasonable, we can schedule a short call to walk through. Would Thursday morning PST work?

Also: quick ask for you — if you have a target $/1M token you’d prefer we use to anchor scenario C, share it. Otherwise we’ll anchor scenario C at $700/1M tokens and show +/− 20% sensitivity.

Best,
Hannah

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Token consumption check + early commitment / incentive ask

Thanks for the ping, Hannah — I reviewed Alex’s CSV and Hannah’s notes. I’ve attached the pricing workbook with three scenarios (tabbed): PAYG, 12mo COMMIT, 24mo BLENDED. Key guidance:

- Startup founder credit: we can offer a $10k one-time credit applied to initial invoices for qualifying seed-stage companies (subject to eligibility).
- 12-month committed banding: for a 12mo guaranteed monthly commit within the 25–35M range we can table a 18–28% effective per-token reduction vs PAYG (tiered by commit band).
- 24-month blended: if customer signs a 24mo plan with escalating commit bands, we can layer the $10k credit plus an additional 10% rebate tied to milestone usage.

Notes/next steps for the AE:
1) Hannah — upload final workbook to HubSpot and send Alex the link with the three scenario tabs.
2) Ask Alex to confirm which scenario they want modeled with a mid-case token ramp so we can surface an indicative monthly invoice impact.
3) If Alex wants the 24mo blended, we’ll require a bit more diligence (usage SLA, quarterly reviews).

I attached: olivetech_pricing_workbook.xlsx (three scenarios) and the CSV you provided was normalized into the MVP_estimate tab.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
